content: Padilla Miami 8 & 11 is a premium, hand-crafted cigar brand owned by the Padilla Cigar Company. The blend for this cigar was developed by José Pepin Garcia, a renowned figure in the cigar industry. These cigars are meticulously manufactured at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, which is located in the Little Havana neighborhood of Miami, Florida. The name 8 & 11 is derived from the factory's location, near the intersection of 8th Street and 11th Avenue in Miami. The Padilla Miami is a full-strength cigar. It features a wrapper made from Nicaraguan-grown Cuban-seed Corojo tobacco. The filler is a blend of Nicaraguan Criollo and Corojo tobaccos, while the binder is composed of Nicaraguan Criollo. The cigar's band is designed with a black background and gold lettering. At its center, there is a prominent gold-bordered monogram P, with the word Miami displayed in gold on a red background beneath the monogram. These cigars are packaged without cellophane in boxes containing 20 units. One specific size of the Padilla Miami, the Belicoso Fino (5 x 52), is exclusively available through a single retailer. Additionally, the Salomons size is uniquely rolled by Don Pepin Garcia himself, ensuring a level of craftsmanship that is unparalleled.
